title: DeepSeek pauses its second fundraising round after founder’s leaked investor comments go viral

content_html:
TL;DR

DeepSeek halted its second fundraising round after leaked comments from founder Liang Wenfeng about Nvidia reliance went viral

DeepSeek has suspended its second fundraising round after comments made by founder Liang Wenfeng during private investor meetings were leaked and went viral on Chinese social media, Bloomberg reported on Friday. Liang verbally informed prospective backers to hold off on the round, which had been targeting a pre-money valuation of roughly 480 billion yuan, equivalent to about $71 billion. The pause came after Liang expressed frustration that his candid remarks about China’s dependence on Nvidia chips and the country’s AI gap with the United States had been shared publicly without his permission.

The company closed its first funding round in June, raising roughly $7 billion from investors including Tencent, battery giant CATL, and China’s National AI Industry Investment Fund. That round valued the Hangzhou-based startup at between $50 billion and $52 billion, making it one of the most valuable AI companies in the world. DeepSeek has also been designing its own AI chip in an effort to reduce its reliance on Nvidia hardware, which is subject to US export restrictions that have limited Chinese access to the most advanced processors.

The leaked comments touched on sensitive ground for a Chinese AI company. Liang reportedly told investors that China remains behind the United States in AI capability and that DeepSeek still depends heavily on Nvidia’s chips despite the export controls. Those remarks, once made public, drew widespread attention on Weibo and other platforms, putting the company in an uncomfortable spotlight at a time when Beijing has been promoting the narrative that Chinese AI firms are rapidly closing the gap with their American rivals.

Despite the funding pause, DeepSeek appears to be preparing for a public listing and may file for an initial public offering as soon as this year, according to people familiar with the matter. Liang, whose net worth Bloomberg estimates at $36 billion, is the wealthiest AI model creator in the world, ranking above Anthropic co-founder Dario Amodei and former OpenAI president Greg Brockman. DeepSeek is owned by Zhejiang High-Flyer Asset Management, the hedge fund Liang founded before pivoting to artificial intelligence research.

The company has signalled that it prioritises aggressive pricing and open-source development over short-term revenue, a strategy that has won it a large developer following but also raised questions about how it plans to sustain itself financially. Liang has pledged to continue developing open-source AI models, a commitment that differentiates DeepSeek from most Western competitors but complicates the economics of raising capital at a $71 billion valuation. Whether the funding pause is a brief interruption or a sign of deeper tension between DeepSeek’s research ambitions and investor expectations will depend on how quickly the controversy fades.

content_html_zh:
TL;DR

DeepSeek 创始人梁文峰关于依赖 Nvidia 的评论被泄露后，停止了第二轮融资

据彭博社周五报道，在创始人梁文峰在私人投资者会议上的言论被泄露并在中国社交媒体上疯传后，DeepSeek 暂停了第二轮融资。 梁先生口头通知潜在支持者推迟本轮融资，该轮融资的投前估值目标为约 4800 亿元人民币（约合 710 亿美元）。 梁先生对中国对英伟达芯片的依赖以及中国与美国在人工智能方面的差距的坦诚言论未经他的许可就被公开表示感到沮丧。

该公司于 6 月完成第一轮融资，从腾讯、电池巨头宁德时代和中国国家人工智能产业投资基金等投资者筹集了约 70 亿美元。 该轮融资对这家杭州初创公司的估值在 500 亿至 520 亿美元之间，使其成为世界上最有价值的人工智能公司之一。 DeepSeek 还一直在设计自己的人工智能芯片，以减少对英伟达硬件的依赖，英伟达硬件受到美国出口限制，限制了中国获得最先进的处理器。

泄露的评论触及了一家中国人工智能公司的敏感领域。 据报道，梁告诉投资者，中国在人工智能能力方面仍然落后于美国，尽管有出口管制，但 DeepSeek 仍然严重依赖英伟达的芯片。 这些言论一经公开，就在微博和其他平台上引起了广泛关注，在北京方面一直宣扬中国人工智能公司正在迅速缩小与美国竞争对手的差距之际，该公司陷入了令人不安的聚光灯下。

据知情人士透露，尽管融资暂停，但 DeepSeek 似乎正在为公开上市做准备，并可能最早在今年申请首次公开募股。 梁的净资产彭博社估计为 360 亿美元，是世界上最富有的人工智能模型创建者，排名高于 Anthropic 联合创始人达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 和 OpenAI 前总裁格雷格·布罗克曼 (Greg Brockman)。 DeepSeek 隶属于浙江翰飞资产管理公司，该公司是梁在转向人工智能研究之前创立的对冲基金。

该公司已表示，它优先考虑激进的定价和开源开发，而不是短期收入，这一策略为其赢得了大量开发商的追随，但也引发了人们对其计划如何维持财务维持的质疑。 梁承诺继续开发开源人工智能模型，这一承诺使 DeepSeek 与大多数西方竞争对手区分开来，但使以 710 亿美元估值筹集资金的经济性变得复杂。 融资暂停是短暂的中断还是 DeepSeek 的研究雄心与投资者期望之间更深层次紧张关系的迹象，将取决于争议消退的速度。
